standard.summary: Shampoo 因子的指数平均系数。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The exponential-average coefficient of the Shampoo factor.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: Shampoo 因子的指数平均系数。-1 = 使用 beta2（默认）；如需单独设定，取值范围 -1 ~ 1。

advanced_en.principle: Exponential-averaging coefficient for the Shampoo factors. -1 = use beta2 (default); to set it independently, range -1 ~ 1.
